message.text:
Only the s3presign runner is started. It runs once immediately during Server.Start. memopayload.NewRunner is defined but never invoked. RebuildMemoPayload is the only runner used from the request path.

The s3presign ticker fires every 12 hours via Run(). No cron library exists. Webhook spawns four worker goroutines from package init, but these are not runners started by the server itself.

s3presign.Runner — immediate RunOnce at Server.Start, then time.Ticker every 12 hours (server/server.go, server/runner/s3presign/runner.go)
memopayload.Runner (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go) — NewRunner/RunOnce never called; only RebuildMemoPayload is used synchronously from CreateMemo/UpdateMemo.
